Attached: 4 images

Do not start with the tool. Start with the task you repeat.

Name one real weekly task, score it on four tests — repeated, clear input, easy to check, cheap mistake — then match the tool to the task and test it on a real example for 20 minutes.

The move: one task, one tool, one week, one number to track.

Link in bio. #AIexplained #smallbusiness #productivity
